original_amendment.change: All formal A0,R1,B2,P0,P1 child processes receive identical64GiB virtual-address-space soft/hard limit via prlimit; process timeouts remain registered; at most6 active VPR jobs including concurrent preparation
original_amendment.reason: Bound large-graph candidate caches and avoid uncontrolled aggregate memory consumption on shared host
original_amendment.failure_policy: Keep memory-limit terminations as resource failures in registered denominator; no silent retry with extra memory

scope: Independent strict-thread reexecution before formal training; historical inputs and outcomes remain separate.
limits: Preserve inherited 64 GiB address-space limit, registered timeouts and at most six owned concurrent VPR processes.
thread_observation: strace follows descendants and records clone/clone3; flag any CLONE_THREAD attempt, supplemented by 10 ms /proc process-tree sampling. Report missing observations as infrastructure failures.
instrumentation_timing: ptrace can perturb wall time and timeouts; traced durations are diagnostic only and do not establish uninstrumented speedup. Independently specify and qualify non-ptrace serial timing before use.
selection: Select only from new training data before heldout; preserve all failed and unstarted outcomes.
input_provenance: Pre-existing packed census and models are reused as frozen inputs; this reexecution is not a strict-thread reproduction of upstream preprocessing.
core_dump_policy: Disable child core dumps with prlimit core=0:0; preserve logs, status and other outputs. Historical two 64 GiB core files remain unchanged.
training_free_space_guard: Check shared filesystem free space before each training placement and route; stop and preserve receipts below 80 GiB. Active jobs drain; this is a guard, not a guarantee against concurrent external consumption.
